'''Ryan Hase Ral Ops''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Ryan Hase]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds117.htm Ral Ops], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
